name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.pointsOver_nonempty_of_noMultipleNear
summary: pointsOver_nonempty_of_costs with I = {0} × windows: no element of the windows is a nonzero multiple of p, so each step costs d, and there are at most 8n + 4 of them.

steps.claim: Apply pointsOver_nonempty_of_costs to the point of hx and I = {(0, y) : y ∈ twoWindows(n, b) ∪ twoWindows(n, −b)}; all needed steps lie in I (H).
steps.lean:
pointsOver_nonempty_of_costs hx.some_mem
  (.image (.mk 0) (twoWindows n b ∪ twoWindows n (-b))) (by grind)

steps.claim: The total cost: Σ_{(0,y)∈I} cost(0, y) = Σ (v_p(y) + d) with v_p(y) = 0 on the windows (hs: a multiple of p there is 0, and v_p(0) = 0), so it is |I|·d ≤ (8n + 4)·d (|twoWindows| ≤ 4n + 2).
steps.lean:
(by
    grw [sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ k.differentExp, card_image_le]; repeat grw [card_union_le]
    all_goals grind [cost, NoMultipleNear, padicValInt.eq_zero_iff, Int.card_Icc])
